sample.heading: Sample day
sample.banner: Preview sample. These are example tasks only. They are not a real assignment, and nothing has been marked finished for you.

tasks.title: Read the sample card out loud
tasks.instruction: Open the sample reading card linked on this page. Read the three sentences out loud.
steps: If you miss a word, read that sentence again.
tasks.finishedMeans: You have read all three sentences on the sample card out loud.

tasks.title: Write three sentences
tasks.instruction: On paper, write three sentences about one object you can see.
steps: Choose one object you can see.
Write a sentence that names the object.
Write a sentence about its color or size.
Write a sentence about where it is.
tasks.finishedMeans: The paper has three sentences about the same object.

tasks.title: Count six objects
tasks.instruction: Use six small, safe objects such as spoons or blocks.
steps: Place exactly six objects in a line.
Touch each object as you count from one to six.
Say the last number out loud.
tasks.finishedMeans: Six objects are in a line, and you said six.
